verdict.rationale: SerpApi documents search-results scraping across many engines, markdown output of those results, and an MCP server that lets agents use it as a web search tool. The pack has no evidence of an endpoint that extracts contents from result pages or synthesizes answers. Only the search step of the multi-step flow is covered, so the agent would need other tools to extract and synthesize. That is an adjacent building block, not the single-API research flow the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent run a multi-step research flow — search, extract contents, and synthesize — through one API
